title: 第25章 护身玉符第26章 山岩蛮熊 出手相救
content_zh:
第25章护身玉符
在少堂主的脖子上，挂着一道玉符。
如今这玉符，正缓缓释放这灵力，凝聚出了这一道屏障，挡下了楚风眠的剑锋。
“这是，护身玉符？”
看到这玉符，楚风眠突然眉头紧锁起来。
这护身玉符，那是一种极为特殊的灵器，品级最低也要玄品以上。
是一些高阶武者，以上品灵玉，注入灵力制造而成的，一般都是一些大家族长老，用来送与家族一些年少天才，以保护他们之用的。
这种护身玉符凝聚出来的屏障，少说也足以持续数个时辰的时间，其中眼前这道屏障，除非是锻体境武者，不然绝无可能打破。
楚风眠也没想到，这少堂主身上，还有着护身玉符的存在。
“小子，今天你杀不了我！”
少堂主看着身上出现的屏障，阴冷笑道。
“这护身玉符打开，我父亲肯定就知道我有危险，倒时候等我武炎堂的弟子赶来，就是你的死期！”
“放心，倒时候本少可不会让你那么快死的！
本少会将你抽魂炼魄，让你慢慢的死！”
“只能先走了。”
楚风眠看了一眼那少堂主，也知道这次是没有机会了。
这少堂主所的也没错，这护身玉符里面有着高阶武者的灵力，一旦催动，那武者定然知晓发生了危险。
还留在这里，极为危险，如今只能先撤。
楚风眠也没有任何犹豫，身形一动，便是向着蛮荒山脉的深处跑去。
“倒是错失了一次机会，不过这蛮荒山脉，地域广阔，就算是武胜学院的人前来，一时半会也找不到我。”

楚风眠心中想道。
他的身份，那少堂主应该还不知道，这样一来倒是还足以拖延一段时间。
“只要给我一些时间，不要是一个小小的武炎堂，就算是武胜学院，我也有力量足以对抗。”
楚风眠心中暗自说道，再一次向着蛮荒山脉深处跑去。
他现在的境界已经突破，倒是可以在寻找一些更加强大的妖兽猎杀了。
实力突破到淬骨境八重，同时开辟了第四条灵脉，就算是面对锻体境的妖兽，楚风眠心中也有着自信有着一战之力。
“必须要尽快，提升实力才行！”
楚风眠心中暗自说道。
以武胜学院的势力，想要查出楚风眠身份，用不了多久时间，楚风眠必须要在这身份暴露之前，尽可能提升自己实力才行。
一路之上，楚风眠所遇到的一些淬骨境八重，九重的妖兽，已经全部是被楚风眠所斩杀。
一枚枚妖丹，也落入到楚风眠的储物袋中。
“这些武胜学院的中年人，虽然只是些奴仆，但是一个个倒是都极为富有啊。”
一处山洞之中，楚风眠坐在山洞里，将那九个储物袋中的东西全部拿了出来。
从中一口气拿出了大大小小接近五十个玉瓶。
这些玉瓶之中，装载的都是各色丹药，其中最多的，便是一种白色龙眼大小的丹药。
这种丹药，足足占据了四十个玉瓶，算起来也得有着四五百枚。
“这应该就是武胜学院所炼制的聚气丹了吧。”

Chapter 25 Protective Jade Talisman
There is a jade talisman hanging around the young hall master's neck.
Now this jade talisman is slowly releasing its spiritual power, condensing this barrier to block Chu Fengmian's sword edge.
"Is this a protective jade amulet?"
Seeing this jade talisman, Chu Fengmian suddenly frowned.
This protective jade talisman is a very special spiritual weapon, the lowest grade is Xuan Grade or above.
It is made by some high-level warriors and above-grade spiritual jade injected with spiritual power. It is usually used by some elders of big families to give it to some young geniuses in the family to protect them.
The barrier condensed by this kind of protective jade talisman is enough to last for several hours at least. Among them, the barrier in front of you is absolutely impossible to break unless you are a body-forging realm warrior.
Chu Fengmian also didn't expect that the young hall master still had a protective jade talisman on his body.
"Boy, you can't kill me today!"
The young hall master looked at the barrier appearing on his body and smiled sneerly.
"With this protective jade talisman open, my father will definitely know that I am in danger. If not, when my Wuyan Hall disciples arrive, you will die!"
"Don't worry, I won't let you die so quickly when the time comes!
This young master will extract your soul and refine it, and let you die slowly! "
"I have no choice but to leave first."
Chu Fengmian glanced at the young hall master and knew that there was no chance this time.
What the young hall master said was correct. This protective jade talisman contained the spiritual power of a high-level warrior. Once it was activated, the warrior would definitely know that there was danger.
It is extremely dangerous to stay here, so now we can only retreat first.
Chu Fengmian didn't hesitate at all. He moved and ran towards the depths of the wild mountains.
"I missed an opportunity, but this wild mountain range is so vast that even if someone from Wusheng Academy comes, they won't be able to find me for a while."
Chu Fengmian thought to himself.
The young hall master probably doesn't know his identity yet, which is enough to delay it for a while.
"As long as you give me some time, don't be a small Wu Yantang. Even Wu Sheng Academy, I have the strength to fight against it."
Chu Fengmian said secretly in his heart, and once again ran towards the depths of the wild mountains.
Now that his realm has been broken through, he can now look for some more powerful monsters to hunt.
With his strength breaking through to the eighth level of the Bone Tempering Realm and opening up a fourth spiritual vein, Chu Fengmian was confident that he could fight even against monsters in the Body Forging Realm.
"We must improve our strength as soon as possible!"
Chu Fengmian said secretly in his heart.
With the power of Wusheng Academy, it won't take long to find out Chu Fengmian's identity. Chu Fengmian must improve his strength as much as possible before his identity is exposed.
Along the way, all the monster beasts at the eighth and ninth levels of the Bone Tempering Realm that Chu Fengmian encountered had been killed by Chu Fengmian.
Each demon pill also fell into Chu Fengmian's storage bag.
"Although these middle-aged people from Wusheng Academy are just slaves, they are all extremely wealthy."
In a cave, Chu Fengmian sat in the cave and took out all the contents of the nine storage bags.
He took out nearly fifty jade bottles of various sizes in one breath.
These jade bottles contain all kinds of elixirs, the most numerous of which is a white dragon eye-sized elixir.
This kind of elixir occupies a full forty jade bottles, so there must be four to five hundred of them.
"This should be the Qi Gathering Pill refined by Wusheng Academy."
